title: Han Feng's End
summary: Xiao Yan wakes at the Falling Star Pavilion after three days and shows Yao Lao his 11 Bodhisattva Seeds and the Bodhisattva Heart. In the Hun Clan, the leader scolds Hun Yu for coming back with nothing. Xiao Yan tries to break through to Dou Sheng but cannot, and Yao Lao refines a Bodhisattva Pill that draws an eight-colored thundercloud to help him. Before going into seclusion, Xiao Yan hands Yao Lao the soul of Han Feng. Han Feng begs, then attacks with a move taught by Mu Gu, and Yao Lao, now a Ban Sheng, destroys him. Later the Ling Clan of the Eight Ancient Clans vanishes. Old Demon Tian Ming of the Profound Sky Sect attacks the Falling Star Pavilion's camp in the Tianxing Mountain Range and wrecks its Wormhole, with the Hall of Souls behind him.
events: Xiao Yan wakes after three days at peak Ninth Turn Dou Zun.
He shows Yao Lao 11 Bodhisattva Seeds and the Bodhisattva Heart.
The Hun Clan leader scolds Hun Yu and Gu You.
Xiao Yan fails to cross into Dou Sheng; Yao Lao gives him the Bodhisattva Pill.
Xiao Yan goes into seclusion and gives Yao Lao Han Feng's soul.
Han Feng attacks Yao Lao with a move from Mu Gu and is destroyed.
The Ling Clan and the Ling Realm vanish; the Hun Clan is suspected.
Old Demon Tian Ming attacks the Tianxing Mountain Range camp; the Profound River Alliance is named.
introduced: Hun Clan leader (Hun Miesheng, named in EP240)
cultivation: Xiao Yan went from Eight-Star Dou Zun to peak Ninth Turn Dou Zun on the trip. He cannot yet break through to Dou Sheng. Old Demon Tian Ming is a Ban Sheng. Yao Lao is a Ban Sheng.
